shared_classes: assets/page.css: .chip/.chip--s|a|p/.chip-word/.chip-role/.chip-gloss/.erg/.word (optional for widgets to reuse; do not restyle them globally)

w-alignment-lens.container: .lens-canvas (sticky scrolly canvas; desktop column ~ 520-560px wide at top 12vh, max-height 70vh; mobile full width, sticky top 0, max-height 55vh, overflow hidden)

size.mobile: 100% × ≤ min(340px, 55vh − 16px); 3-segment mode switch under the rows, targets ≥ 44px

attributes.data-step: 1 = plain chips, no S/A/P letters or role colours, no outline; 2 = letters + role colours; 3 = letters + colours + group outline (+ labels). ergative-english and basque always arrive with step 3
attributes.data-unlocked: space-separated states the mode switch may offer (starts 'english'; page adds 'ergative-english' when k-03 is committed, 'basque' when its step is reached)

inputs.event_in: 'lens:update' CustomEvent dispatched on the mount by assets/page.js, detail { state, step, unlocked: [..], source: 'scroll' | 'gate' }. Read the attributes at init too: the page may set them before the widget script runs
inputs.event_out: 'lens:mode' CustomEvent, bubbles, dispatched from the mount when the reader uses the mode switch, detail { state }. The page then sets data-state to that state and data-step=3; the next scroll step change overrides it

w-alignment-lens.content: per learning-plan.md w-alignment-lens model: english (She slept. / She saw him.; outline S+A 'same form'), ergative-english (Her slept. / She saw him.; outline S+P 'same form'; persistent tag 'Made-up English: no one speaks this'), basque (Martin etorri da. 'Martin has arrived.' / Martinek Diego ikusi du. 'Martin has seen Diego.'; outline S+P 'no ending (absolutive)'; tag on A '-k/-ek (ergative)'; '-ek' in var(--erg) with var(--erg-ink) text). Mode label in canvas corner. aria-live line describing the grouping

w-basque-decoder.container: prose column inside .d-main, class d-wide (≤ 960px; keep content ≤ 680px)

size.desktop: ≤ 680px wide, ~420px per puzzle, puzzles stacked, later ones locked
size.mobile: 100%, chips wrap, full-width Check, ~480px per puzzle

w-basque-decoder.event_out: optional: 'decoder:check' (bubbles) detail { puzzle: 1|2|3, correct: bool } and 'decoder:complete' (bubbles). The page does not depend on them
w-basque-decoder.content: per learning-plan.md w-basque-decoder model and k-04/k-05 (prompts, options, feedback). The 'Every noun here is singular.' banner, per-chip glosses, da/du clue, Try again, Reset all and the summary line are inside the widget

inputs.event_in: 'didactician:commit' on document with detail.id === 'k-07' unlocks the switch
